## Appearance

Aunt Martha is a character who is deaf and half blind. She is also described as being very childish in her demeanor.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VI. MARY STAYS AT THE MANSE P15](../source/v05-c06.md#nw-v05-c06-p0015)_

## Personality

Aunt Martha is an elderly, cranky, and fretful woman who is both half-blind and very deaf. Though she is a very poor housekeeper and cook, she childishly insists on managing the household's provisions, while remaining skilled enough to knit thick, heavy stockings. Not one to care for fresh air, she can be grumpy when offered assistance, yet she remains devoted to [Cecilia](../character/cecilia-meredith.md) and firmly insists that everyone attend church regardless of the weather.

## History

Aunt Martha, a cousin of John Meredith's mother, was taken into the manse by Mr. Meredith to save her from going to the poorhouse. When runaway [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) came to stay at the manse, Aunt Martha clashed slightly with her over the cooking while Mary assisted with house chores. Later, Aunt Martha fell bedridden with an illness, leaving [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to manage the household and care for a sick [Carl](../character/carl.md) until her recovery. She eventually caused an uproar with [Faith](../character/faith.md) when she killed Faith's pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), to serve as dinner for a visiting minister, Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER II. SHEER GOSSIP P2](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER II. ## Relationships

### [Faith](../character/faith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-martha--faith.md)

Aunt Martha is the aunt of [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md). She resides at the manse with the family, but her ability to maintain order is limited. When Aunt Martha is bedridden with an illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) attempts to manage the household and do the cooking in her absence, which leads to major domestic difficulties and community scandals until Aunt Martha recovers to resume her duties.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P84](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0084)</sub>

### [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-martha--john-meredith.md)

Aunt Martha is the aunt of the widowed minister, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), and lives with him to help care for his family. While Mr. Meredith often becomes completely absorbed in his books and theology, Aunt Martha helps maintain the household at the manse. Her presence provides essential support, though the family household remains chaotic due to his absentmindedness and her limited capacity to handle the children.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XIV. MRS. ALEC DAVIS MAKES A CALL P37](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0037)</sub>

### [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-martha--una-meredith.md)

Aunt Martha is the aunt of young [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md). She lives in the manse to help look after [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and her siblings, though the children are largely left to run wild. When Aunt Martha falls ill and becomes bedridden, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) and her sister [Faith](../character/faith.md) try to take over managing the home and caring for their sick brother, facing great difficulty with the cooking and chores until Aunt Martha gets better.

- Relative of — aunt  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER V. THE ADVENT OF MARY VANCE P26](../source/v05-c05.md#nw-v05-c05-p0026)</sub>
